senses.gloss: (cmp. preced.; corresp. to h. טבל) to dip, immerse.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 12:22">Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 22</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>טְמִישׁ</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 80:6">Targ. Ps. LXXX, 6</cite> (not <cite ref="I00546"><he>טַמִּ׳</he></cite>).
Targ. Ruth II, 14 (ed. Amst. Pe.); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>וטַמְּשֵׁיה במיא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ואמשייה מייא</he>) and dipped it in water.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74a">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>וטמשיה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אמשינה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6).
Gitt. 69ᵃ ונִיטמֵּישׁ וכ׳ (or ונִיטְמִישׁ) and let him dip them &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. מְטַמַּשׁ bathed, washed.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 24:8">Targ. Job XXIV, 8</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>מִטַ׳</he> Ithpa.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 60:10">Targ. Ps. LX, 10</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sukkah 10b:3">Succ. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>אִיטְּמִישָׁא ליה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>אשתמיטא</he>, cler. error for <he>אִתְטְמִישָׁא</he>) his garment became soaked with water.
